newsitem.title: ITALY: Canal Plus near deal on Kirch's Telepiu stake-Sole.
newsitem.headline: Canal Plus near deal on Kirch's Telepiu stake-Sole.

text.p: French company Canal Plus and German media group Kirch are close to a deal to sell Kirch's 45 percent stake in Italian pay-television Telepiu, Italian financial daily newspaper Il Sole 24 Ore said.
Il Sole gave no source for the report but said an accord, which would give Canal Plus a 90 percent stake in Telepiu, was imminent.
The remaining 10 percent is held by Italian media magnate Silvio Berlusconi's Fininvest group.
No one was yet available at Fininvest for comment.
